title: Junior Estimator – Water, Sewer & Drainage
rationale: Junior Estimator at a Hoppers Crossing water, sewer and drainage contractor, about 20 minutes from Melton, which is the best location fit possible.

Reading civil drawings and specifications, stormwater drainage coursework (Advanced Diploma, February 2026), procurement and materials tracking and Microsoft Office from his field engineer role match parts of the brief.
Advert asks for approximately 1 to 3 years in estimating or tendering, which Marc does not have; that lowers the score but is phrased as approximate rather than essential.
caution: No estimating or tendering experience and no Expert Estimation; the application must say so plainly. Screening question on estimator years should be answered as no experience.
gaps: No estimating or tendering experience (advert asks approximately 1 to 3 years)
No Australian water or sewer project experience
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (no link out). Screening: right to work, years as an estimator, current driver's licence.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Estimator?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
